definitions.explanation: Beyond what is possible or reasonable.

examples.japanese: {無理|むり}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{言|い}わないで→言う：00515_iu⟧。
⟦{今日中|きょうじゅう}→今日中：19382_kyoujuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{終|お}わらせる→終わる：00567_owaru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{無理|むり}です。
examples.english: It's impossible to finish it today.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{予算|よさん}→予算：03663_yosan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{面|めん}→面：09933_men⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{無理|むり}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}います→思う：00492_omou⟧。
examples.english: I think that plan has problems budget-wise.

examples.japanese: ⟦{一人|ひとり}→一人：00630_hitori⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦やる→やる：02980_yaru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{無理|むり}だから、⟦{手伝|てつだ}ってくれる→手伝う：00898_tetsudau⟧？
examples.english: It's impossible to do it alone, so could you help me?

examples.japanese: {無理|むり}しないで⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
{無理|むり}して⟦{食|た}べなくていい→食べる：00396_taberu⟧⟦よ→よ：09475_yo⟧。
examples.english: You don't have to force yourself to eat.

examples.japanese: ⟦{体調|たいちょう}→体調：04644_taichou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧⟦とき→〜時：03094_toki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{無理|むり}をしないで⟦{休|やす}んで→休む：00606_yasumu⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: When you're not feeling well, don't push yourself and please rest.

examples.english: When I was young I could push myself, but as I get older it takes time to recover.

examples.english: As a result of pushing myself and staying up all night to meet the deadline, I got sick.

notes:
{無理|むり} expresses impossibility, unreasonableness, or overexertion.

FUNCTIONS:
- Noun: {無理|むり}だ (it's impossible)
- Na-adjective: {無理|むり}な⟦{要求|ようきゅう}→要求：03658_youkyuu⟧ (unreasonable demand)
- Verbal: {無理|むり}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to push oneself too hard)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {無理|むり}しないで: don't overdo it
- {無理|むり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧: to make unreasonable demands
- {無理|むり}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: there are problems, it's unreasonable
- {無理|むり}もない: it's understandable

COMPOUNDS:
- {無理|むり}⟦{矢理|やり}→矢理：noentry⟧: forcibly, by force
- {無理|むり}⟦{難題|なんだい}→難題：16722_nandai⟧: unreasonable demand

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {無理|むり}: impossible, forced ↔ ⟦{可能|かのう}→可能：00175_kanou⟧: possible
- {無理|むり}: unreasonable ↔ ⟦{当然|とうぜん}→当然：01591_touzen⟧: natural, reasonable

USAGE:
{無理|むり}しないでね is a common expression of concern meaning "don't push yourself."
